tickets.title: Prepare charitable funding comparison
tickets.text: Prepare a comparison for Nia Bramblequill of how a securities gift, donor-advised account, or cash gift would affect taxable income, portfolio concentration, and cash retained for tuition and renovation spending. Use the household’s compensation, unrealized gains, mortgage interest, and prior giving level to inform the comparison.
tickets.evidence: Nia asked how a securities gift, donor-advised account, or cash gift would affect taxable income, portfolio concentration, and cash retained for tuition and renovation spending. They agreed to prepare the comparison by December 12, 2025.
